title: Rav Nachman bar Yehudah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 6:8, Rabbi Yaakov bar Acha and Rabbi Zeira report, one in the name of Mar Ukban and the other in the name of Rav Nachman bar Yehudah. Hyman states that the text undoubtedly originally had the initials RNBY, meaning Rav Nachman bar Yaakov, which became bar Yehudah.

notes.text: The consulted Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 6:8 gives bar Yehudah in this report. Bar Yaakov occurs in a separate nearby statement.
